status.sh Git → 4) Push a release to production (lib/production_push.sh): git fetch --no-tags origin + one ls-remote of main, production and v* tags; refuses on either failure. Shows production's tip and newest 5 tags on it (tip marked), then up to 5 newest vX.Y.Z on origin main, not on production, descending from its tip. Confirm → git push origin <sha>:refs/heads/production (no force), then ls-remote check. No terminal: prints the command. Offered y/N after Cut a release.

export.sh --prod (lib/prod_export.sh): --tag removed. Reads origin production live; tip must be exactly an origin release tag, VERSION must match, local tag must equal it (fetched if missing); worktree under .temp/prod-export/; runs the tag's own export.sh with --production-worktree. That flag works only in a detached checkout under .temp/prod-export/, and the child refuses to build unless stable AND origin production + tag == HEAD. BOE_PROD_EXPORT_CHILD is gone. Traps set before mktemp.
status.sh Exports → Build + ship APKs → production now builds in the same production worktree (prod_apk_from_production) and ships with expected git = production tip, mode prod.

deploy.sh --prod: version stable, git_sha 40-hex, git_dirty via manifest_git_dirty (only boolean false passes; string "false", null, missing refused), git_sha == origin production tip AND origin tag (one ls-remote). Ancestry check and post-deploy offer removed. remote_release_refs_match (origin/main) removed with its two release_tag_contract asserts.

Dashboard: show_production_branch reads production live via ls-remote, shows it next to the prod stack version status already fetched, warns on mismatch, says when the newest tag is not on production.

The child refuses non-stable builds up front instead of building a dev bundle.

Choice: the worktree runs the TAG's own export.sh, so a bundle is a function of the tag incl. tooling. Tags <= v0.18.6 carry the old origin/main gate: their worktree build comes out dev and the parent refuses it. The next cut after landing works.

Choice: --with-apk links keystore.properties, keystore/* files, local.properties from the operator checkout (each must be gitignored at the tag) and runs npm ci in packages/contracts and frontend_stack_ts. UNVERIFIED: not run (Gradle needs permission). STATIC: links keep a clone clean; frontend reads only VITE_BEO_* vars that boe_update.sh sets, so no .env.local in the worktree is harmless.

Choice: --yes or no terminal never moves origin/production; the git push command is printed. Missing git_dirty in a manifest now counts as dirty (old jq default read it clean). Dev export labels use the same tag gate (stable when origin has the tag, main irrelevant); dev deploy unchanged.
